use_drop_path_function: use the drop_path function to apply stochastic depth dropout to a tensor with a given drop probability
create_DropPath_module: create a DropPath module to apply stochastic depth dropout per sample in residual blocks
build_GraphDropPath_module: build a GraphDropPath module to apply stochastic depth dropout considering batch indices for graph data
create_EquivariantDropout_module: create an EquivariantDropout module to apply equivariant dropout using e3nn irreps and elementwise tensor product
use_EquivariantScalarsDropout_module: use an EquivariantScalarsDropout module to apply dropout only to scalar irreps in equivariant tensor data
